cases.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: standalone cat identity reference image for LoRA inference testing.

Composition/framing: STRICT PORTRAIT WIDTH 480 HEIGHT 832 pixels (aspect ratio 15:26). Single cat, dead-center horizontal placement, sitting upright naturally on hindquarters, face and chest toward camera, looking into lens, eyes open, closed mouth, ears upright. Camera at cat eye level. Entire body, both ears, front and hind paws and WHOLE tail clearly inside frame. Cat height approximately 74 percent of the image, topmost ears near 14 percent from top, feet near 86 percent; comfortable clean margin around all extremities and tail. Tail curves naturally on floor beside body without leaving frame. Accurate natural feline anatomy.
Style/medium: realistic high-quality studio animal photography, crisp fine fur and whiskers, identifiable face and distinctive markings, realistic eyes with modest catchlights; neutral color rendering and soft diffuse frontal lighting with gentle dimensional shading.
Constraints: a new individual identity, only ONE cat, opaque clean gray background. No collar, no clothing, no accessories, no props, no furniture, no people, no logos, no text, no watermark, no border, no collage, no contact sheet, no graphic decoration. No extra limbs, duplicated tail or malformed paws. Output one single full-bleed portrait, not multiple pictures.
